# Creatibly

> > Creatibly is a full-service Shopify agency offering unlimited graphic design, web development, copywriting, and digital marketing services with flat-rate monthly subscriptions.

Creatibly specializes in providing freelance and agency services for ecommerce brands, with a focus on Shopify expertise, branding, and content creation. The platform offers both unlimited subscription models and individual freelancer hiring options, led by founder Scott Luscombe.

## Key Topics

- Shopify agency
- Unlimited graphic design
- Web development
- Ecommerce
- Freelance services
- Copywriting
- Branding
- Digital marketing
- Flat-rate pricing
- Monthly subscription
- SEO
- UX/UI design
- Full-service agency
- Unlimited revisions
- Client acquisition
